original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Sharp outside-root-code rank budget for arbitrary exact all-pairs m-term E8 decoders; complete rank-one residual form at m=10; real versus complex symmetric factors and exact attaining witnesses.
scope_change_reason: The assigned card requests a physical larger-rank decoder. Existing PRs cover many support families and PR1605 already screens rank-one reblocking. This session instead supplies a necessary algebraic constraint and a ten-term parametrization for the unrestricted overcomplete escape route; it does not satisfy the physical-construction acceptance gate.
bottleneck_link: Side result for complex decoder synthesis: any candidate with m terms must allocate at most m-8 outside-code rank across its factors. Ten terms permit only one outside-code direction on each side. This prunes a search model but does not improve copied rank or the recursive moment.
stop_rule: Finish within about 60 minutes, reserving at least 15 minutes for exact checks, source/overlap refresh and handoff. Stop if the rank statement is already explicitly covered or cannot be justified without a cost-preserving gauge assumption.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the all-m residual-rank feasible region, its complete two-sided ten-term form, and the real/complex symmetric distinction. RESULT.json records 168 general and 32 symmetric complex exact examples, four extracted ten-term forms, two rank algorithms and ten controls. independent.py checks the P112 witness and both copy invoices without predecessor imports; test_verify.py supplies six focused regression groups.
author: Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, verification and writing; no independent human or subagent review.

open_questions.question: Can a two-sided ten-term decoder in this residual rank-one form reduce the P112 copy bill below 64?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This class escapes the both-root-code floor while being the first possible two-sided term count.
open_questions.first_step: Search the original term coordinates under AB^T=2I, Bz=0, Aw=0 and z^T w=0, and charge every support pairing rank.
open_questions.blocked_by: No cost-preserving term gauge or physical realization is supplied; the general coefficient/support search remains open.

declared_domain: Universal theorem for any full-rank real n-by-8 root matrix over R or C, ordinary transpose; finite fixtures P112 and P120, m=8..14, all feasible residual ranks.
optimistic_full_cost_budget: No physical candidate or moment improvement is proposed. The necessary-condition side result does not satisfy the original card construction gate. Explicit copy examples cost 82 and 90, compared with the usual P112 bill 64.

final_overlap.limits: Remote PR scope is open PRs including drafts. Closed work is searched through local READMEs, TASK metadata and ledger only. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
